fields.label: Existing SKU
fields.description: Pick an SKU that already exists — it must match this estimate's mode. Leave blank to create one from the columns to the right.

fields.label: Room
fields.description: Required when creating a new SKU.

fields.label: SKU / Article Name
fields.description: Required when creating a new SKU — the SKU code (YS_MB_WAR) is generated on save.

fields.label: Part List CSV (CSV-Nest)
fields.description: Creates a CSV-Nest SKU: sheets are nested here and re-nested across the estimate's SKUs (shared-material saving).

fields.label: Material Estimate PDF (OCL)
fields.description: Creates an OCL-PDF SKU instead: sheet counts come already packed from OpenCutList — standalone, no shared-material saving.

fields.label: Part List PDF (OCL)
fields.description: Optional companion of the Material Estimate PDF — identifies hardware designations and edge-band metres.

fields.label: 7 Views PDF
fields.description: SketchUp Layout 7-views export with annotated outer dimensions.
